chunks: Hamzah ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alavi (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hamedany said: Yahya ibn al-Hasan ibn Ja'far narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Maymun al-Khazzaz narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Maymun narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ali ibn al-Hussein (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Six [groups/people] are cursed by God, and every Prophet whose call is accepted [testifies to this]: The one who adds to God's Book; the one who denies the Divine decree; the one who abandons my Sunnah; the one who considers permissible regarding my Itrat (Ahl al-Bayt) what God has forbidden; the one who takes power by force to debase those whom God has honored and honor those whom God has debased; and the one who monopolizes the booties of the Muslims, considering them legitimate for himself.

key_terms.الزَّائِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: The one who adds to God's Book (Quran)

ai.seo_question: What are the six groups cursed by God according to this hadith from al-Khisal?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq presents this hadith in *Al-Khisal* as a concise enumeration of six specific sins that incur divine curse, emphasizing their universal validation by all responsive Prophets. The list covers theological deviations like altering the Quran and denying *al-Qadr*, alongside socio-political transgressions such as monopolizing *fi' al* (public treasury) and misusing authority to humiliate the dignified, reflecting key Shia concerns regarding leadership and justice.
